notes.title: Here are your Xbox Games with Gold for January
notes.content:
Purse strings feeling the pinch after Christmas? Weather still crap outside? Xbox has a mixed bag of freebies* to keep you busy this January.

(*obviously only free if you subscribe to Xbox Live Gold, just to pre-empt your dash to the comment section)

New release The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing 3 is available now until 31st January, while Wii U port Zombi will be free from the 16th to 15th February.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - ZOMBI
notes.content:
ZOMBI is Now Available on Steam!

London is falling. Are you prepared? The Last Blight is upon us. It was foretold. For the second time in history, a great plague has shrouded London in a fog of death. Big Ben tolls as thousands of unprepared die, or worse, are infected by a sickness more gruesome than death.
